mapper.sql: SELECT p.professor_id, p.name, p.department, p.title, p.teacher_type, p.status FROM ms_professor p

SELECT r.record_id, r.course_id, c.course_name, c.credit_value as credit_per_course, r.professor_id, p.name as professor_name, p.department, p.title, p.teacher_type, r.semester, r.student_count, r.calculated_score, r.is_research FROM ms_teaching_record r LEFT JOIN ms_course c ON r.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN ms_professor p ON r.professor_id = p.professor_id WHERE r.status = '0' AND p.status = '0'
mapper.select: SELECT p.teacher_type, COUNT(DISTINCT r.professor_id) as professor_count, COUNT(r.record_id) as record_count, COALESCE(SUM(r.student_count), 0) as total_students, COALESCE(SUM(r.calculated_score), 0) as total_credits, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.is_research = '1' THEN r.calculated_score ELSE 0 END), 0) as research_credits FROM ms_teaching_record r LEFT JOIN ms_course c ON r.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN ms_professor p ON r.professor_id = p.professor_id WHERE r.status = '0' AND p.status = '0' AND r.semester = #{semester} AND p.department = #{department} GROUP BY p.teacher_type ORDER BY total_credits DESC

SELECT p.department, COUNT(DISTINCT r.professor_id) as professor_count, COUNT(r.record_id) as record_count, COALESCE(SUM(r.student_count), 0) as total_students, COALESCE(SUM(r.calculated_score), 0) as total_credits, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.teacher_type = '1' THEN r.calculated_score ELSE 0 END), 0) as research_professor_credits, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.teacher_type = '2' THEN r.calculated_score ELSE 0 END), 0) as teaching_professor_credits, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.teacher_type = '3' THEN r.calculated_score ELSE 0 END), 0) as dual_professor_credits, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.teacher_type = '4' THEN r.calculated_score ELSE 0 END), 0) as admin_professor_credits FROM ms_teaching_record r LEFT JOIN ms_course c ON r.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN ms_professor p ON r.professor_id = p.professor_id WHERE r.status = '0' AND p.status = '0' AND r.semester = #{semester} AND p.teacher_type = #{teacherType} GROUP BY p.department ORDER BY total_credits DESC

SELECT p.department, COUNT(DISTINCT r.professor_id) as professor_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.teacher_type = '1' THEN r.professor_id END) as research_professor_count, COALESCE(SUM(r.calculated_score), 0) as total_credits, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.teacher_type = '1' THEN r.calculated_score ELSE 0 END), 0) as research_credits FROM ms_teaching_record r LEFT JOIN ms_course c ON r.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN ms_professor p ON r.professor_id = p.professor_id WHERE r.status = '0' AND p.status = '0' AND r.semester = #{semester} GROUP BY p.department ORDER BY research_credits DESC

SELECT p.teacher_type, COUNT(DISTINCT r.professor_id) as professor_count, COUNT(r.record_id) as record_count, COALESCE(SUM(r.calculated_score), 0) as total_credits, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.is_research = '1' THEN r.calculated_score ELSE 0 END), 0) as research_credits FROM ms_teaching_record r LEFT JOIN ms_course c ON r.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN ms_professor p ON r.professor_id = p.professor_id WHERE r.status = '0' AND p.status = '0' AND r.semester = #{semester} GROUP BY p.teacher_type ORDER BY total_credits DESC

SELECT r.record_id, c.course_id, c.course_name, c.course_code, r.credit_per_course, r.student_count, r.calculated_score as total_course_credits, CASE WHEN r.student_count > 0 THEN r.calculated_score / r.student_count ELSE 0 END as per_student_credits, r.professor_id, p.name as professor_name, p.department, p.title, p.teacher_type, r.semester, r.is_research FROM ms_teaching_record r LEFT JOIN ms_course c ON r.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN ms_professor p ON r.professor_id = p.professor_id WHERE r.status = '0' AND r.semester = #{semester} AND p.department = #{department} AND p.teacher_type = #{teacherType} ORDER BY r.calculated_score DESC

SELECT p.professor_id, p.name as professor_name, p.department, p.title, p.teacher_type, COUNT(r.record_id) as record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT r.course_id) as course_count, COALESCE(SUM(r.student_count), 0) as total_students, COALESCE(SUM(r.calculated_score), 0) as total_credits, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.is_research = '1' THEN r.calculated_score ELSE 0 END), 0) as research_credits FROM ms_teaching_record r LEFT JOIN ms_course c ON r.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN ms_professor p ON r.professor_id = p.professor_id WHERE r.status = '0' AND p.status = '0' AND r.semester = #{semester} AND p.teacher_type = #{teacherType} AND p.department = #{department} GROUP BY p.professor_id, p.name, p.department, p.title, p.teacher_type ORDER BY total_credits DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.professor_id) as total_professors, COUNT(DISTINCT r.course_id) as total_courses, COUNT(r.record_id) as total_records, COALESCE(SUM(r.student_count), 0) as total_students, COALESCE(SUM(r.calculated_score), 0) as total_credits, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.teacher_type = '1' THEN r.calculated_score ELSE 0 END), 0) as research_credits, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.teacher_type = '1' THEN r.professor_id END) as research_professor_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.department) as total_departments FROM ms_teaching_record r LEFT JOIN ms_course c ON r.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN ms_professor p ON r.professor_id = p.professor_id WHERE r.status = '0' AND p.status = '0' AND r.semester = #{semester} AND p.department = #{department}
SELECT DISTINCT semester FROM ms_teaching_record WHERE status = '0' AND semester IS NOT NULL AND semester != '' ORDER BY semester DESC
SELECT DISTINCT department FROM ms_professor WHERE status = '0' AND department IS NOT NULL AND department != '' ORDER BY department
